change: Remove temporary String copies from collectionHash and collectionEquals:, retaining the existing current-vtable queries and identity policy.

contract.before: Query current vtables, then copy the owned bytes for hashing or content equality. Non-default vtables use the existing identity policy.
contract.after: Perform the same queries in the same order, then borrow the owned buffers only for the pure hash/comparison. Identical Oops still compare equal before any vtable query.
preserved: Exact FNV-1a byte hash and identity fallback algorithm.
Left-to-right vtable-query order and short-circuit behavior.
Identity semantics for Strings with changed behavior and captured collection equality on other Oops.
Existing errors when content comparison is selected but owned String storage is absent.
No private borrow crosses a dependency message; no foreign payload is read.

microbenchmark.scope: Existing collectionHash, collectionEquals: and one-entry Map lookup using distinct equal String keys. Input lengths 16 bytes, 4 KiB, 1 MiB. Serial ABBA, five samples per process. Normal GC policy; every hash/equality/lookup result checked.

validation: String/Error tests plus added checks for the exact byte hash, live query counts, self-equality query omission, changed-vtable identity policy and captured collection equality.
Persistent collection tests with independent sequences, hash collisions and reentrant equality.
Full Oop core/compiler/GC and negative dispatch/construction contracts.
limits: The Map measurements use one entry and distinct equal String keys. They are not whole-application speedups.
Hashing remains linear in input size; its 1 MiB timing is essentially unchanged.
Only String differs in the comparison prefixes; no installed user prefix was replaced.
